takeaways: The portfolio was built docs-first: product discovery, a 47-requirement functional spec, and ADRs were all locked before any component was written.
Every feature traces to a numbered requirement, was implemented with tests written before code, and was validated against production metrics like Lighthouse ≥ 90 and WCAG 2.2 AA.
The process is intentional proof-of-work — showing scope decisions, tradeoffs, and structured thinking is more signal than shipping another todo app.
The architecture is designed to compound: v2 starts from a locked v1 baseline rather than re-deriving decisions from scratch.
